messages:
Maya (CS): quick sync — Ember Health asked for a concise breakdown of our service commitments for their migration. They want uptime evidence, p50/p95 latency, and potential credit calc if we missed targets. Can we align on what we'll send by EOD? cc @Raj (SE) @Erin (Platform PM)
Raj (SE): got it. Which prod cluster? ember-prod-east? If we pull from metrics, we need the timeframe — last 30 days?
Maya (CS): yes, ember-prod-east, last 30 days. They specifically called out a 99.95% uptime target and ~150ms p95 latency. They want both raw numbers and supporting traces/postmortems.
Felix (SRE): I can run the uptime reconciliation. Will need the incident list from PagerDuty for that window. @Oncall Bot, can you drop the incident export here?
Oncall Bot: export ready — /exports/incidents/ember-prod-east-171920.zip :file_folder:
Erin (Platform PM): For latency, we should use the `redwood.latency.v2` metric filtered by `cluster:ember-prod-east`. I'll pull p50/p95 and the histogram. Draft query below:
```sql
SELECT percentile(lat_ms, 50) as p50, percentile(lat_ms, 95) as p95 FROM redwood.latency.v2 WHERE cluster='ember-prod-east' AND ts >= now() - 30d
```
Run that and paste output. I’ll format it for the customer.
Raj (SE): note — we had a canary deploy 10 days ago that injected extra tail latency for ~6 hours. That will bias p95. We should flag it and provide adjusted numbers excluding that window.
Maya (CS): good catch. Ember will want both raw and adjusted. Can we produce both?
Felix (SRE): yes. I'll compute both. Deliverables I’ll produce: raw uptime %, incident-adjusted uptime %, p50/p95 raw, p50/p95 adjusted, and a short incident list with durations + links to postmortems.
Maya (CS): timeline? EOD today would be ideal; otherwise morning tomorrow.
Erin (Platform PM): I can assemble a one‑pager. Raj/Felix — drop numbers here by 16:00 PT and I’ll prepare the PDF + audit trail.
Raj (SE): will run the query now. Also, do we want to mention KV-cache warmup effects on first-token latency? That affected early requests after deploys.
Maya (CS): yes — add a short note on cache warmups. Ember cares about steady‑state tail latency.
Felix (SRE): copying postmortem link for canary: https://redwood.internal/pg/pm/ember-canary-2026 :memo:
Oncall Bot: incident export link updated: /exports/incidents/ember-prod-east-171920-2026-03-21.zip
Maya (CS): thanks. I'll draft the customer email after Erin shares the one‑pager. Action items:
- Felix (SRE): uptime & incident-adjusted calc + incident list (by 16:00 PT)
- Raj (SE): p50/p95 raw and adjusted latency numbers + query (by 16:00 PT)
- Erin (Platform PM): assemble one‑pager, attach audit trail, produce candidate email (by 18:00 PT)
I’ll send after signoff. :thumbsup:
Raj (SE): noted. Posting query output in 10 mins.
Felix (SRE): starting computation now. Ping if you need alternate time windows.
Maya (CS): appreciated. @Erin feel free to loop me into a quick review before sending.
